Definition: Jehonadab, the name of an Israelite and of an Arab
BiblicalUsage: Jehonadab is the name of an Israelite and of an Arab, and the Rechabite who rode with Jehu is the best known. In 2 Samuel 13:5, Jonadab said unto him. The fuller story is told on the Jehonadab, Son of Rechab profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jehonadab shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
